verdict: Pass for the no-block promise. The 12 provided Wild decks have coverage showing valid deck input can produce a load-safe package. Source-backed richness is strongest for 9 core fixtures; Kingslayer and Boarlock remain source-informed controls; CuteWarrior is supplemental load-safe coverage.
source_backed_claims: All 12 listed decks are covered by test_universal_wild_no_block_matrix.py for VALID_PACKAGE, runtime_load_safe=true, runtime_apply_mode=load_safe_apply, GlobalValues.json, Mulligan.json, per-card JSON in normal prepare output, and no normal-path Presume.json or Concede.json.
The representative matrix has 11 decks: 9 core_source_backed_fixture rows and 2 source_informed_valid_fixture rows.

Core source-backed coverage includes hero-power transform, aggro/burn targeting, recruit/aura, pirate/weapon pressure, big/recruit/deathrattle, discard, token/board buff, hero power/spell generation, mech/magnetic, and hero attack.
Boarlock is the current representative Combo.json control row, but this is narrow combo competence, not proof that every combo archetype is exhausted.
repo_evidence: The local universal Wild no-block test includes ShadowPriest, CtAPaladin, PirateRogue, BigShaman, Discolock, TreantDruid, ImbueMage, MechPala, Kingslayer, Boarlock, PirateDH, and CuteWarrior.
Local focused test run in this audit passed 143 tests including the universal Wild matrix and scope/sync checks.
Existing fixture scans from subagent audit found representative source-document fixtures for 11 decks; CuteWarrior is supplemental.
no_block_implication: Valid decks should not be blocked just because they are not source-strong, lack broad combo proof, include warning-only mechanics, or still need guide depth. Load-safety is a structural contract; source-strength is a quality label.
mechanic_or_surface_gaps: Kingslayer still needs exact Quick Pick/Kingsbane mulligan evidence for source-strong promotion.
Boarlock still needs exact Boarlock-relevant Fracking mulligan evidence for source-strong promotion.

Generated/random pools, board placement, generic targeting, location activation, secret timing, Dredge, Tradeable, and unknown future mechanics remain diagnostics-only unless exact documented VisionAI syntax and identity are available.
CuteWarrior is not yet a representative mechanic-breadth fixture.
bloat_or_scope_risk: Expanding the representative matrix without a specific mechanic gap would add maintenance cost.
Inventing runtime rows for warning-only mechanics would make the skill broader and less reliable.
Historical research folders can create noise if they are treated as operator guidance.
recommended_next_actions: Keep the representative matrix at 11 and keep CuteWarrior supplemental unless it is promoted for a specific mechanic family.
Keep warning-only mechanics report-only until a documented VisionAI surface and exact source-backed identity exist.
Only close Kingslayer or Boarlock source-informed gaps with exact new guide evidence.
Maintain the distinction: no-block load safety is broad; source-backed mechanic richness is intentionally narrower.
uncertain: Public guide/source URLs inside fixtures were not refreshed by the local mechanic-breadth subagent.
Live HearthRanger runtime behavior was not sampled.
